_about: Keys of the _comfy_bridge block of a ComfyBridge workflow (API JSON). Read by Nuke to check workflows on load and by the ComfyUI exporter to build them. Types: string, text, bool, int, number, enum (values), node (an id of the workflow, of one of the classes), object (keys), list (item, max), pair (a [node, input] list), any. 'default' is what ComfyBridge uses when the key is missing.

name.doc: Name in the library list. Default: the file name.

description.doc: Shown under the library. Simple HTML is fine.

source.doc: Where the workflow comes from (credits, licence). Not used by Nuke.

output.doc: color: an image, back through the inverse viewer transform. data: depth / matte / normals, back raw.

sequence.doc: no: one image at a time. batch: frames are independent (can be chunked). temporal: the whole range in one job.

media.doc: Library type. Default from sequence: temporal -> video, batch -> both, no -> image.

plate_node.doc: LoadImage that receives the plate. Default: the first LoadImage that is not the mask or an extra input.

save_node.doc: Node the result is taken from. Default: the first save / preview node.

mask_channels.doc: alpha: the mask alpha in all channels. rgba: the mask input as it is.

matte.doc: The result's alpha is a matte: output it as alpha.

match_format.doc: Scale the result back to the plate format. false: keep its own size (upscalers, outpaint).

send_exposure.doc: false: generative workflow that does not keep the exposure it gets; send exposure is reset to 0.

sampler_params.doc: Also show the KSampler inputs (seed, steps, cfg, sampler, scheduler, denoise) as knobs.

work_size.doc: Working size set when the workflow is loaded (heavy video models).

output_scale.doc: Scale of the result against what was sent (used with constraints.size_multiple).

frame_ratio.doc: Output frames per input frame (frame generation: N -> 2N-1).

out_colorspace.doc: The result is already scene-linear in this space: the Read is tagged with it.

frames_rule.doc: The last frame is repeated to fit, extra frames dropped on return.

size_multiple.doc: Padded to this multiple and cropped back.

node.doc: A LoadImage gets an 8-bit PNG, a Load EXR (ComfyBridge) a float EXR.

label.doc: Name shown in the Inputs tab.

from.doc: Which Nuke input it comes from.

layer.doc: Layer of that input (depth, a render pass...).

send.doc: color: through the viewer transform like the plate. data: raw.

match_exposure.doc: Gets the same send exposure as the plate.

params.doc: Inputs of the workflow shown as knobs in Parameters.

input.doc: Input name of that node (dynamic inputs with a dot, e.g. resize_type.width).

label.doc: Knob label. Default: the input name.

type.doc: Default from the current value. text: multi-line (prompts).

options.doc: Fixed choices (a dropdown). Model inputs get the server's list anyway.

default.doc: Default value. Default: the value in the workflow.

also.doc: More [node, input] pairs that get the same value.

models.doc: Model files to add to (or correct in) the download list.
